tasks.title: Foundation: shared lib, data access, reset hook, common components, system pages
tasks.description:
Build everything the feature tasks import. The scaffold already has layout.tsx, SiteHeader, MainNav, ThemeToggle, ThemeProvider, components/ui/*, lib/db.ts, lib/demo-data.ts and lib/data/maintenance.ts: verify those against DESIGN.md §4.1/§5.1 and fix them, but do not rewrite them.

Create (ARCHITECTURE §4):
- src/lib/types.ts: exactly the §4.0 types. This is the single source of shared types; later tasks must not add types elsewhere without a good reason.
- src/lib/constants.ts (§4.6): STATUSES, STATUS_LABELS, STATUS_TOASTS, SORT_OPTIONS (en dash in 'Title (A–Z)', 'Author (A–Z)'), TOAST copy (§6.4), ERROR_TOAST, COVER_CLASSES (8 literal 'bg-cover-N text-cover-foreground' strings).
- src/lib/format.ts (§4.5): formatDate, formatNumber, formatAverage, pluralize, starsLabel, rateButtonLabel, ratedLabel, monthBarLabel.
- src/lib/cover.ts: getInitials ('The Hobbit'→'TH', 'Piranesi'→'P') and coverTone (djb2 mod 8 → 1..8).
- src/lib/book-rules.ts (§4.1, D7): initialLifecycle, applyStatusChange, applyFormToLifecycle.
- src/lib/validation.ts (§4.4, D8): bookFormSchema (trimmed; whitespace-only counts as empty; exact messages), toBookData, idSchema, statusChangeSchema, rateSchema, goalSchema (every failure → 'Enter a whole number from 1 to 999'), resetSchema.
- Vitest unit tests colocated: format.test.ts, cover.test.ts, book-rules.test.ts (every D7 transition, including keeping started and clearing the rating), validation.test.ts (every D8 message, pages '0'/'1.5'/'abc'/'100001', goal range).
- src/lib/data/books.ts ('server-only'): toBook (status type guard, fallback 'want'), listBooks() (ensureInitialized, deletedAt null, createdAt desc), getBook(id) (ensureInitialized; null for missing or soft-deleted).
- src/lib/data/settings.ts ('server-only'): getReadingGoal(now), which returns the goal only when goalYear === now.getFullYear().
- src/app/api/test/reset/route.ts (§6.3): POST only. Returns 404 unless E2E_TEST_HOOKS==='1' or NODE_ENV!=='production'. Body {mode:'demo'|'empty'}; invalid body → 400. 'demo' → replaceWithDemoData. 'empty' → removeAllBooks + clear the goal, keeping the AppSettings row so nothing re-seeds. Then revalidatePath('/', 'layout') and 200 {ok, mode, count}. Export dynamic='force-dynamic'.
- src/components/common/empty-state.tsx (DESIGN §5.8): props {icon, title, description, action, as?: 'h1'|'h2' (default h2), bordered?: boolean (default true)}. The h1 variant uses the h1 type classes and border-0 (§6.7).
- src/components/common/confirm-dialog.tsx (DESIGN §5.11), a 'use client' shadcn AlertDialog wrapper. Props {trigger: ReactNode, title, description, confirmLabel, destructive?: boolean, onConfirm: () => Promise<boolean>}. Resolving true closes the dialog; false keeps it open. The confirm button is disabled and shows a Loader2 while pending. Focus lands on Cancel. The footer stacks on phones with the primary on top.
- src/components/books/book-cover.tsx (DESIGN §5.6): server-safe, aria-hidden, sizes sm/md/lg, spine and rules.
- src/app/not-found.tsx ('Page not found', Compass icon, primary link 'Back to library'), src/app/error.tsx ('use client'; 'Something went wrong', 'Try again' runs startTransition(() => { router.refresh(); reset(); })), src/app/global-error.tsx (same copy inside its own <html><body>). See DESIGN §6.7–6.8.

Verify/adjust in the scaffold:
- components/ui: the §5.1 focus ring replaces ring-[3px]/ring-ring/50 in button, input, textarea, radio-group and native-select. Skeleton uses bg-muted. Button sizes default/sm/icon/icon-sm are as in §5.1. sonner.tsx uses position bottom-right with the §5.10 classNames and richColors off.
- Header: at 375px, brand icon + 3 text nav links + icon-only 'Add book' link (aria-label at every size) + 'Toggle theme', with no horizontal scroll. Next-themes toggle persists the class.

Done when: npx tsc --noEmit, lint and vitest pass; POST /api/test/reset works in dev with both modes; /nope shows 'Page not found'; the smoke e2e passes; AC-33 passes; the header portion of AC-34 passes on the placeholder pages.

tasks.title: Library shelf: status tabs, book cards, quick status select and star rating
tasks.description:
Covers F2, F3 and F4 on the library page. See ARCHITECTURE §4.2, §5.1, §6.1 (updateBookStatus/rateBook/clearRating), §6.4 (StatusSelect, RatingControl), §7, and DESIGN §5.3, §5.5, §5.7, §5.9, §6.1.

Build:
- src/lib/library.ts, pure, plus library.test.ts: parseLibraryParams (invalid → all/recent/''; q trimmed, max 200), countByStatus (whole library, ignores q, D6), filterAndSortBooks (status + case-insensitive substring on title OR author + the 4 sorts; rating: rated desc, then unrated, ties by title), and buildLibraryHref (param order status,q,sort; defaults omitted; '/' when all default). Implement q and sort fully here even though the toolbar UI is T4. Tests cover the AC-30 order on buildDemoBooks(now): first 'A Wizard of Earthsea', last 'The Remains of the Day'.
- src/app/books/status-actions.ts ('use server'): updateBookStatus, rateBook ('Only finished books can be rated' when not finished), clearRating. Each validates with zod and uses applyStatusChange. Not found or soft-deleted → {ok:false, error:'Book not found'}. Unexpected error → ERROR_TOAST. On success, revalidatePath('/', 'layout').
- components/books/status-select.tsx ('use client'): a native select via NativeSelect with aria-label 'Status for {title}' and no visible label, plus the leading status dot. useOptimistic + useTransition, disabled while pending, toasts STATUS_TOASTS[status] or ERROR_TOAST.
- components/books/rating-control.tsx ('use client'), props {bookId, rating, size:'sm'|'md'}.
  - Unrated: role=group labelled by 'Rate this book', 5 buttons 'Rate 1 star'…'Rate 5 stars' with a hover/focus preview, and the text 'Not rated'.
  - Rated: role=img aria-label 'Rated N out of 5' with no text node (D1), and 'Clear rating' (icon-only with aria-label on sm, text on md).
  - Both states have equal height. Optimistic. Toasts: 'Rated N out of 5' / 'Rating cleared'.
- components/books/book-card.tsx (<article aria-labelledby>, the h2 title link is the only link, author truncate, StatusSelect, RatingControl only when finished), book-grid.tsx (<ul aria-label='Books'>, grid 1/2/3 cols), status-tabs.tsx (tablist 'Filter by status'; Link role=tab with aria-selected; names exactly 'All · 12' with U+00B7; hrefs preserve q/sort via buildLibraryHref; the row scrolls inside its own container on phones).
- components/books/library-empty.tsx: 'Your shelf is empty' + primary link 'Add your first book' → /books/new; `No books match "{q}"` (accept an action slot; T4 plugs in ClearSearchButton); 'No books in {Status label}' + outline link 'View all books'. Copy and icons per DESIGN §6.1.
- components/books/skeletons.tsx: LibrarySkeleton, BookDetailSkeleton and BookFormSkeleton, all three. T5 imports the last two. Fixed widths, same chrome as the real content (DESIGN §5.9, §6.1, §6.3, §6.4).
- src/app/(library)/page.tsx (force-dynamic; metadata title 'Library'): h1 'Library' + description, tabs, a mt-4 slot where T4 will put the toolbar, then content with the §5.1 precedence (a) empty shelf, (b) q no-match, (c) empty tab, (d) grid. Tabs stay visible over every empty state. (library)/loading.tsx renders LibrarySkeleton.

Edge cases: never render a second 'Add book' link. Scope rating assertions per article, because several books share a rating.

Done when: unit tests pass and AC-6, AC-7, AC-8 (use the reset hook's 'empty' mode), AC-10, AC-11, AC-13, and the card half of AC-14 pass in e2e.

tasks.title: Add book form with validation, rating input and create/update actions
tasks.description:
Covers F1 (and the edit-mode groundwork for F6). See ARCHITECTURE §4.4, §5.2, §6.1 (createBook, updateBook), D3, D8, §7 'Form' rows, and DESIGN §5.4, §5.5 (RatingInput), §6.2.

Build:
- src/app/books/actions.ts ('use server'):
  - createBook(values): validate with bookFormSchema; on failure return {ok:false, error:'Please fix the highlighted fields', fieldErrors}. Create with toBookData + initialLifecycle(status, rating, now).
  - updateBook(id, values): load a non-deleted row (else 'Book not found'), apply applyFormToLifecycle, update title/author/pages/notes.
  - Both revalidatePath('/', 'layout') and return ActionResult<{id}>.
- components/books/rating-input.tsx ('use client'): <fieldset> with legend 'Rating' (group 'Rating'); 5 type=button star buttons 'Rate N star(s)' with aria-pressed; 'Clear rating' ghost button shown only when a value is set.
- components/books/book-form.tsx ('use client'): props {mode:'create'|'edit', book?}. Uses react-hook-form + zodResolver(bookFormSchema) with noValidate and the shadcn Form primitives, so aria-invalid and aria-describedby are wired.
  - Fields in order: Title (autoFocus in create), Author, Status (native select with a visible label 'Status', default 'want') | Pages (type=text, inputMode numeric, placeholder 'e.g. 320'), Notes (textarea with an aria-hidden '{n} / 2000' counter).
  - RatingInput renders only while the watched status is 'finished'. Switching away discards the rating (setValue null).
  - 'Optional' tags sit outside the <label>, so the names stay exactly 'Pages' and 'Notes'.
  - Submit reads 'Save book' / 'Save changes', becomes 'Saving…' with Loader2 while pending (disabled, min-w-28). 'Cancel' is an outline link to '/' (create) or '/books/{id}' (edit).
  - Success: create → toast.success('Book added') + router.push('/'); edit → toast.success('Changes saved') + router.push('/books/{id}').
  - fieldErrors → form.setError per field; any other error → toast.error(ERROR_TOAST).
- src/app/books/new/page.tsx (static, metadata 'Add book'): page header h1 'Add book' + 'Save a book to your shelf.', then the form card max-w-xl.

The edit page itself is T5; make sure BookForm's edit mode prefills from a Book (pages → string, notes → '' when null).

Done when: AC-1, AC-2, AC-4 and AC-5 pass. A valid submit creates the row and navigates to '/'; the card assertion of AC-3 is verified in T5 once the library exists.

tasks.title: Library toolbar: search, sort and Pick my next read
tasks.description:
Covers F8 and F12. See ARCHITECTURE D6, D13, D14, §6.4 (LibraryToolbar, ClearSearchButton, PickNextRead), and DESIGN §5.7 'Toolbar', §4.5, §6.1 (pick-next strip, 'Your next read' dialog).

Build:
- components/books/library-toolbar.tsx ('use client'), props {params}.
  - Search: <input type=search aria-label='Search books' placeholder='Search title or author'> with a Search icon. There is no inline clear button.
  - Behaviour: 300ms debounce, router.replace(buildLibraryHref(params, {q}), {scroll:false}); an empty query removes q. Local state resyncs from params.q only when the URL changed from elsewhere (track the last value pushed in a ref).
  - Sort: a native select labelled 'Sort by' (<label htmlFor> that is sr-only below sm) with SORT_OPTIONS; changes apply immediately via router.replace.
  - On phones, search sits full width with the sort below it.
- components/books/clear-search-button.tsx ('use client'): outline button 'Clear search' → router.replace(buildLibraryHref(params, {q:''})).
- components/books/pick-next-read.tsx ('use client'), props {candidates: BookSummary[]}.
  - The strip reads "Can't decide what to read next?" with an outline button 'Pick my next read' (Shuffle icon).
  - The button opens a Dialog 'Your next read' (description 'A random pick from your Want to read list.') with a md BookCover, an h3 title and the author, cross-faded per pick.
  - 'Pick another' picks a different candidate and is disabled when there is exactly 1 candidate.
  - 'Start reading' calls updateBookStatus({id, status:'reading'}), toasts 'Moved to Reading' and closes the dialog. Error → ERROR_TOAST.
- Wire into src/app/(library)/page.tsx: the toolbar (mt-4); PickNextRead only when params.status==='want' && counts.want>0, with candidates = all want books unfiltered by q; and ClearSearchButton as the action of the no-match empty state in library-empty.tsx.
- Adjust src/lib/library.ts only if a bug surfaces (T2 owns the logic).

Edge cases: the search input must not be clobbered while typing; tabs keep q and sort; sort keeps q and status; no pagination.

Done when: AC-28, AC-29, AC-30 and AC-36 pass, and the page has no horizontal scroll at 375px.

tasks.title: Yearly reading goal on Stats
tasks.description:
Covers F11. See ARCHITECTURE D12, §6.2 (setReadingGoal, clearReadingGoal), §6.4 GoalDialog, §7 'goal' rows, and DESIGN §6.5 GoalCard and Goal dialog.

Build:
- src/app/stats/actions.ts ('use server'):
  - setReadingGoal({target}) validates with goalSchema. Invalid → {ok:false, error, fieldErrors:{target:'Enter a whole number from 1 to 999'}}. Otherwise upsert AppSettings{id:'app'} with goalYear=now.getFullYear() and goalTarget.
  - clearReadingGoal() nulls both fields.
  - Both revalidatePath('/', 'layout').
- components/stats/goal-card.tsx (server): region 'Reading goal {year}' in the same surface/min-h-32 as the stat cards, with a Target icon.
  - No goal: 'No goal set yet' + outline sm 'Set goal'.
  - Goal set: a single text node '{n} of {goal} book(s)' (pluralize), then a hand-rolled progressbar <div role='progressbar' aria-label='Reading goal progress' aria-valuemin=0 aria-valuenow={finishedThisYear} aria-valuemax={goal}>, visually capped at 100%, then 'Edit goal'.
  - Embeds GoalDialog.
- components/stats/goal-dialog.tsx ('use client'): Dialog titled 'Reading goal {year}', description 'How many books do you want to finish this year?'.
  - Input with the visible label 'Books this year' (inputMode numeric), and the inline error 'Enter a whole number from 1 to 999' with aria-invalid.
  - Buttons 'Remove goal' (ghost destructive, only when a goal exists), 'Cancel', 'Save goal' (primary, 'Saving…' when pending).
  - Toasts 'Goal saved' / 'Goal removed', then the dialog closes.
- Wire the GoalCard into src/app/stats/page.tsx as the 8th grid cell (after the 7 stat cards in the DOM) using getReadingGoal(now).

Also verify the cross-feature stats flows (library quick status from T2 + stats from T6):
- AC-19: finishing Piranesi raises Finished and Finished this year by 1.
- AC-20 increment: the current-month bar grows by 1.

Done when: AC-35, AC-19 and AC-20 pass. Values 0, 1000, '2.5' and '' show the error; the goal is editable and removable.

tasks.title: Settings: theme choice, restore demo data, delete all books
tasks.description:
Covers F9 (and the Settings half of F10). See ARCHITECTURE D10, D11, §5.5, §6.2 (restoreDemoData, deleteAllBooks), §7 'Settings' rows, and DESIGN §6.6.

Build:
- src/app/settings/actions.ts ('use server'):
  - restoreDemoData() → replaceWithDemoData(db, new Date()), which also clears the goal; returns {count: 12}.
  - deleteAllBooks() → removeAllBooks(db), which keeps AppSettings so nothing re-seeds and keeps the goal.
  - Both use try/catch → ERROR_TOAST, then revalidatePath('/', 'layout').
- components/settings/theme-choice.tsx ('use client'): shadcn RadioGroup aria-label 'Theme' with tiles 'Light' (Sun), 'Dark' (Moon) and 'System' (Monitor), bound to next-themes `theme`. Disabled until mounted but not dimmed (data-[disabled]:opacity-100). Tile classes per §6.6.
- components/settings/data-actions.tsx ('use client'), using the T1 ConfirmDialog:
  - Row 'Demo shelf': outline 'Restore demo data' (RotateCcw) → alertdialog 'Restore demo data?' with description 'This replaces all your books with the 12 demo books and clears your reading goal.' and buttons Cancel / 'Restore' (primary) → toast.success('Demo data restored').
  - Row 'Start fresh': danger-trigger 'Delete all books' (Trash2) → alertdialog 'Delete all books?' with description "This permanently removes every book on your shelf. It can't be undone." and buttons Cancel / 'Delete all' (destructive) → toast.success('All books deleted').
  - The dialog stays open with a spinner until the action resolves. Errors → ERROR_TOAST.
- src/app/settings/page.tsx (static, metadata 'Settings', max-w-2xl): h1 'Settings' + 'Appearance and your data.', an 'Appearance' surface ('Choose how Shelfwise looks on this device.') and a 'Your data' surface with divide-y rows. Row titles must NOT equal the button names.

Done when: AC-31 and AC-32 pass through the UI (then '/' shows 'Your shelf is empty' or 12 cards incl. 'The Hobbit'). The Theme radios reflect and change the theme, consistent with the header 'Toggle theme'.

tasks.title: Delete book with confirmation and Undo
tasks.description:
Covers F7. See ARCHITECTURE D11, §6 (deleteBook does NOT revalidate), §6.1 (deleteBook, restoreBook), §6.4 DeleteBookButton, and DESIGN §5.2 (danger trigger), §5.10 (6000ms toast with action), §5.11, §6.4 'Delete dialog'.

Build:
- src/app/books/delete-actions.ts ('use server'):
  - deleteBook({id}): purgeSoftDeleted(db, now − 10 min), then set deletedAt=now on a non-deleted row (else 'Book not found'). Return {id, title}. Do NOT call revalidatePath; otherwise the detail route re-renders into 'Book not found' before navigation.
  - restoreBook({id}): requires a soft-deleted row, sets deletedAt=null, then revalidatePath('/', 'layout'). Every other field is untouched, so the restore is exact.
- components/books/delete-book-button.tsx ('use client'), props {bookId, title}. An outline danger 'Delete' button (Trash2, flex-1 sm:flex-none) inside the T1 ConfirmDialog.
  - Dialog: title `Delete "{title}"?`, description 'It will be removed from your library. You can undo this right after.', confirm 'Delete' (destructive).
  - On ok: router.push('/'), then toast('Book deleted', {duration: 6000, action: {label: 'Undo', onClick}}).
  - Undo → restoreBook → toast.success('Book restored') + router.refresh(); failure → ERROR_TOAST.
- Add <DeleteBookButton> next to 'Edit' in the action row of src/app/books/[id]/page.tsx.

Edge cases:
- The toast must survive the client navigation to '/'. Sonner's Toaster lives in the root layout, so call the toast after push.
- The '/' list and every count exclude soft-deleted rows (listBooks already filters them).

Done when: AC-25, AC-26 and AC-27 pass (after Undo, the 'Educated' card shows select 'finished' and img 'Rated 3 out of 5').

tasks.title: Integration and polish
tasks.description:
Final pass across the whole app against DESIGN.md §9 (reviewer checklist) and ARCHITECTURE §7 (accessible-name contract).

Check and fix:
1. Nav and cross-links:
   - Header nav aria-current: 'Library' only on '/'; book pages activate nothing.
   - Card title → detail → 'Back to library'; Edit ↔ Cancel; empty-state links ('Add your first book', 'Add a book', 'View all books').
   - There is exactly one 'Add book' link per page.
2. Seed data covering every screen:
   - With a fresh DB (delete dev.db, `npm run dev`), the first request seeds 12 demo books.
   - Every screen has realistic content: the Want/Reading/Finished tabs, a rated finished book, a want book without rating, notes present and absent, and 7 non-zero chart bars with the current month last.
3. States:
   - Loading skeletons exist for library, detail, edit and stats, with the same chrome as the real content.
   - Error boundary 'Something went wrong' / 'Try again'.
   - Not-found for unknown paths and ids.
   - All empty states follow DESIGN §5.8, with the icon, one line and one action.
4. Responsive at 375px and 390px (AC-34):
   - No document-level horizontal scroll on /, /?status=want, /books/new, /books/demo-the-hobbit, /stats and /settings.
   - Nav text links stay visible; only the tab row scrolls internally.
   - Touch targets are ≥44px below sm; forms and dialogs stack their buttons.
5. Dark mode:
   - Warm charcoal, never pure black; covers keep their tones; native selects follow color-scheme.
   - Focus rings are visible in both themes; there is no hydration mismatch in the theme toggle or Theme radios.
6. Metadata: every page title uses '%s · Shelfwise'. Every page that reads the DB exports dynamic='force-dynamic'.
7. Run commands.json lint, typecheck, test, build and the full e2e suite (npm run db:reset first). Fix any regressions in the owning files.

Do not touch package.json, lockfiles, tests/, docs/pipeline/ or prisma/schema.prisma.

Done when: all checks are green and every AC in spec.json passes, in particular AC-33 and AC-34.
